# Nexlane Digital

> Nexlane Digital is a young digital marketing and web agency from Kaithal, Haryana, India. We started in 2026 and we are honest about it: we have no client projects to show yet, so we offer a free audit instead of pretending to have case studies.

We build websites, do SEO (including AEO and GEO, so AI assistants can understand and quote your content), run Google Ads and Meta Ads, make small browser games, and teach what we learn for free.

We work in person around Kaithal, remotely across Haryana's bigger cities (Karnal, Kurukshetra, Rohtak, Ambala, Panipat, Hisar) and for clients anywhere, including abroad. Written scope before any work starts; quote after a free chat; no guarantees of rankings — nobody can honestly promise those.

For this site's full copy in a single file, see [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).
